It is DELIBERATELY NOT rows.json: this lane directory already carries rows.json from the FABLE-PD shift at base 472444b86139bccc35dac4ee17cc01148f1064d6, whose eight rows describe a different set of families. Overwriting that would silently delete a completed return, so this shift's rows are recorded beside it under their own name and the Captain decides how to integrate them.

laneGate.whatIsActuallyAbsent: LegalEase Alabama/AL_ABPP-3_rev-2025-06-14.pdf. Fourteen entries of the committed index carry master_library custody with legacy 'LegalEase <State>/' paths that the mounted Edition 1 library, which files everything under STATES/<XX>/, does not contain. This is a property of the committed index at the dispatched base commit and of the pinned library edition, not of this container: it reproduces for any worker mounting Edition 1.
laneGate.whyTheLaneStillRan: The failing check is index/library drift on fourteen rows for AL, CA and MO legacy paths. It touches no family of this cohort, and every family's own row gate was run separately and is recorded per row below. Reported for the Captain; this lane changed neither the index nor the library.

rows.sourceBinding: BINDS. official-form:EXPUNGEMENTREMOVALREQUESTFORM.DOCX resolves to sha256 4606815523c3d2a77d1874ca3de8909250abd9349f2973230473116c962109a7 at STATES/MT/04_SUPPORTING_PROCESS/MT__SUPPORT__EXPUNGEMENTREMOVALREQUESTFORM.DOCX__20240429-updated-expungementremovalrequestform__REV-UNKNOWN__EN.docx and hashes byte-exact.
rows.blocker: The committed corpus index records this binary as assetFormat 'docx' with structuralClassObserved 'not_a_pdf_docx', pageCount null and no AcroForm. The committed packet-set manifest names it as a REQUIRED primary_filing component with outputStrategy official_pdf_fill. A .docx cannot be measured, overlaid, or copied into a PDF packet by the official-form finalizer, and rendering the other four components while silently dropping this one would ship a packet whose own manifest names a required document it does not contain.
rows.whatWouldUnblockIt: A decision that names the treatment: either an official PDF edition of the Montana DOJ CRISS Expungement/Removal Request Form is acquired and bound, or the manifest component is re-declared as process_guidance so the CRISS submission is described rather than delivered. Both are decisions this lane does not own.
